headline: Citizens' trust in the manat continues to grow - Taleh Kyazymov
summary: The level of dollarisation in Azerbaijan fell by 3.3 percentage points over the year to 25.2 percent, a historic low. The decline indicates growing citizen trust in the manat and the banking sector.
why: Dollarisation levels show how much households and firms rely on foreign currency, which affects monetary policy effectiveness and exchange-rate stability.
